newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - April 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - April 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Dubai's one month shopping festival ended on Saturday.
- Alliance Insurance reported 1996 profits of 10.5 million dirhams. The paper did not specify the kind of profits.

- Egypt has opened up as a new consumption centre for Dubai gold and has contributed to the growth of Dubai's gold exports, said Mohammad al-Abbar, director general of the Dubai Department of Economic Development.
- Kuwait and India have signed a preliminary investment protection and promotion agreement.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak is on a tour of the Gulf to discuss the deadlock in the Middle East peace process.
- Indian conglomerate Southern Petrochemicals Industries Ltd has finalised plans to set up a $160 million fertiliser project in Dubai.
- Kuwait's oil minister said in press comments that OPEC's decision to maintain its official production ceiling was prompting members to continue violating their quotas.
- French footwear sales to the UAE climbed to a record high of 412,000 pairs in 1996 worth about $5 million up 26 percent from 1995.
- Next year's Dubai shopping festival will begin on March 19.
